answer: Bonded collateral in escrows makes equivocation costly: proofs of conflicting signatures for the same consensus step identify coordinated identities, and penalties scale as O(k^2) for k such identities. A sybil swarm therefore cannot dilute liability; upon detection, an exponential multiplier increases aggregate capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation limits recovery. A violet-tagged message at the summit harbor is evidence only if its signatures prove equivocation.
